'''Shadow Squadron''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] assigned to defend the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and enforce [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]{{'s}} orders.

==History==
Shadow Squadron was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that was formed after the end of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Its ranks consisted of former valorous [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilots]] that had devolved into ruthless enforcers as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was born. Shadow Squadron modified their [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-wing]] and [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170]] starfighters to serve the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]]{{'s}} new and more sinister cause, being specially tasked to hunt down pro-Republic remnants after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Legacy" /><ref name="ARC170">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=ARC-170 Fighter|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWvehARC170Shadow.asp}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
Shadow Squadron pilots flew [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighters]] and [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter/bombers]] that were [[Color/Legends|colored]] light-gray with dark-gray markings and stripes. The squadron pilots wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that matched the dark color scheme of their vessels.<ref name="Legacy" /><ref name="ARC170" />

==Equipment==
Shadow Squadron pilots were normally equipped with [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15Ss]], and usually carried [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] specially programmed for navigational support and starfighter repair. ARC-170 pilots used [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4-series astromech droids]] while V-wing pilots were accompanied with spherical [[Q7-series astromech droid/Legends|Q7-series astromechs]] for navigation and in-flight maintenance.<ref name="Legacy" /><ref name="ARC170" />

===Armor===
With the introduction of [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II]] pilot armor in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Shadow Squadron pilots used helmets that were open-faced. Their flight suit was mainly black and the helmet was black marked with a silver stripe as well as the new Imperial insignia in place of the symbol of the Republic. Their chest plates were fitted with forced-ox rebreathers in case of severe damage to their vessel.<ref name="Legacy" />

===Vessels===
After the emergence of the Galactic Empire, war planners determined that a new start was needed for [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval]] fighter craft. Slow, heavy starfighters were de-emphasized in favor of faster and more numerous single-seat strike craft. Since the V-wing was already in limited production, it was given priority. Vast numbers of this dangerous craft were subsequently produced in a short period of time. Shadow Squadron's V-wings had the speed, blasters, and maneuverability to make them formidable weapons. Additionally, they were painted light-gray with dark-gray markings and stripes, and the cockpit canopies were specially tinted to remove combat glare, thereby allowing for open-faced helmets that were clear for ease of instrument viewing.<ref name="Legacy" />

ARC-170s were originally designed and developed by the Republic for assault and recon operations against Separatist forces. Built for endurance rather than speed and maneuverability, the heavy combat fighter/bombers were being phased out for more nimble starfighters with the rise of the new Galactic Empire. Shadow Squadron continued to use the heavy craft for their role in the Empire, modifying and customizing them further than the standard [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] in order to aid in the hunt for Imperial dissidents and pro-Republic sympathizers. Shadow Squadron's ARC-170s were likewise redecorated and redesigned with light-gray paint and dark-gray markings and tinted canopies as the squadron's V-wings were.<ref name="ARC170" /><ref name="Legacy" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[2009]], Hasbro released their Shadow Squadron 3-3/4" ARC-170 and V-wing starfighter vehicles and action figure based on the [[Star Wars: Dark Times]] comic story arc ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times: The Path to Nowhere]]'', particularly issues [[Dark Times 1|1]] and [[Dark Times 2|2]].

A V-wing fighter resembling those of Shadow Squadron was released as a [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] set in [[2011]] under the name "[[W:c:lego:7915 Imperial V-wing Starfighter|Imperial V-wing Starfighter]]." The set features an Imperial pilot, with special black and grey printing, and [[R2-Q2/Legends|R2-Q2]] as included figures. The fighter itself features Imperial roundels and black-and-gray colors.
